source.company_summary: We are an innovative, global provider of communications technologies and services, focused on making connectivity accessible, available and secure for current and future customers worldwide.
product_stack: technology services covering all aspects of satellite communication system architecture

ai_exposure.summary: For example, ViaSat-1 was the highest capacity communications satellite at the time of its launch; ViaSat-2 almost doubled the capacity of ViaSat-1; and the ViaSat-3 F2 and ViaSat-3 F3 satellites are individually anticipated to have significantly greater data capacity and geographic coverage than our ViaSat-2 satellite and to enable us to deliver affordable connectivity across a large geographic footprint spanning nearly one-third of the globe with a design that has an enhanced ability to flexibly and dynamically allocate capacity to markets where bandwidth usage demands and returns are highest. o Customer-Centricity Evolution: We are focused on continuing to increase our customer interactions and have incorporated new technologies, tools and learnings from artificial intelligence and machine learning to enhanced customer intimacy techniques and customer advisory councils.

translation.company_summary: 我們是創新的全球通訊技術與服務供應商，專注於讓全球當前及未來客戶能夠輕鬆取得、隨時連線且安全無虞。
product_stack: 涵蓋衛星通訊系統架構各方面的技術服務

ai_exposure.summary: 例如，ViaSat-1 是當時容量最高的通訊衛星；ViaSat-2 幾乎將 ViaSat-1 的容量翻倍；而 ViaSat-3 F2 與 ViaSat-3 F3 衛星預計具有比 ViaSat-2 衛星顯著更高的數據容量與地理覆蓋範圍，能讓我們在接近全球三分之一的廣大區域內提供經濟實惠的連線服務，且設計具備增強的靈活性與動態能力，能將容量分配至帶寬使用需求和回報最高的市場。o 客戶導向進化：我們專注持續增加與客戶的互動，並結合人工智慧與機器學習的新技術、工具與經驗，提升客戶親密度技巧與顧問委員會。
